highlights: UGREEN AV155, RCA Male To Male Coaxial Braided Cable, 24K Gold-plated Connector, 75 Ohm Impedance, Signal Interference Shielding, Support Dolby Digital, DTS And 5.1 Surround Sound

Coaxial & S/PDIF Compatible: Fits devices with RCA, S/PDIF, and Coaxial ports, including subwoofers, speakers, amplifiers, AV receivers, soundbars, and more.

Visible Flexibility: Soft braided jacket prevents tangles; slim connectors ensure a stable, snug fit for reliable audio transmission.
Wide Application: Ideal for streaming Hi-Fi audio between devices like TVs, soundbars, DVD players, and home theater systems.
